brief:
One year has passed since the death of Abu Obaidah, the military spokesperson for the Izz ad-Din al-Qassam Brigades, the armed wing of Hamas, Shehab Wire reported. Abu Obaidah, whose real name was Hadhifa Samir Abdullah al-Kahlout, served as the public face of the militant group's military operations and became known for regular video statements announcing the organization's activities.

The spokesman gained prominence through his televised addresses to media outlets and the public, communicating Hamas's military positions and operational updates during periods of conflict. His role made him one of the most visible representatives of the armed faction in international coverage of Palestinian militant operations.
